                    ### Question
                    Which of the following antiarrhythmic drugs can produce thyroid alterations as an adverse effect ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Vernakalant.
opb. Amiodarone
opc. Lidocaine
opd. Diltiazem.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Amiodarone is known to contain iodine, which can significantly affect thyroid function, leading to both hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism, thus producing thyroid alterations as an adverse effect. In contrast, Vernakalant, Lidocaine, and Diltiazem are not associated with thyroid function alterations. Vernakalant has no reported thyroid alterations, and both Lidocaine and Diltiazem are not known to affect thyroid function. Therefore, the only antiarrhythmic drug among the options that can produce thyroid alterations is Amiodarone.
